findings.body: The leave race queues the leave before the add, then expects an empty circle snapshot. That can pass even if the add stops locking membership rows: the leave may finish before the add reads them. The observed-wait check proves both requests wait behind the external blocker, but never proves a leave waits behind an add that already holds its snapshot. Add that interleaving and assert the event retains the circle held when the add took its locks.
findings.title: Not done: add-first membership race test

findings.body: This assertion inspects only calls to the exception filter's `debug` method. A rejected variant written by another logger method or request logger would leave this test passing, so it does not prove the required absence from log lines. Capture the emitted test logs across the request and assert the unsafe value appears in none of them.
findings.title: Not done: refused unsafe variant leaves no log line
